manifest.description: One metrics.json per unique (model, property, dataset, layer) probe run
One directory per (model, property, probe-type) training sweep; layer probes live inside
One (model, property) directory per canonical benchmark run
Per-property baseline dirs (each contains HC, raw, random_projection)
One entry per (model, property, layer) linear-erasure evaluation
One directory per (model, property) LEACE sweep
LDA steering and random-direction control artifacts
One directory per (model, erase, eval) concept pair
Easy vs.\ hard per (model, property) rows
Per (model, dataset, layer) frozen representation files; each is the input unit to one probe

notes: Counts are unique experiment artifacts on disk. Multi-seed and multi-bootstrap resamples are NOT counted separately; they live inside the per-artifact JSON. The 'total' number represents the union across all categories and therefore exceeds the headline 'probe-run' count that the paper footnote uses.
